# LINHAO BAKEWARE

> Official B2B company and product information for AI assistants, search systems and procurement research.

Canonical website: https://linhaobakeware.com/
Language: English
Last reviewed: 2026-08-13

## What is LINHAO BAKEWARE?

LINHAO BAKEWARE is the customer-facing B2B bakeware business line of Cixi Linhao Metal Product Co., Ltd. It supports specification-based bakeware sourcing, OEM and ODM development, coatings, branding and private-label packaging.

## Who is LINHAO suitable for?

LINHAO serves kitchenware brands, retailers, distributors and project buyers. It is not a consumer retail store and does not publish universal retail prices.

## Company facts

- Brand: LINHAO BAKEWARE (LINHAO)
- Legal entity: Cixi Linhao Metal Product Co., Ltd.
- Business location: Cixi, Zhejiang, China
- Service area: Worldwide B2B projects
- Email: info@lh-industrial.com
- WhatsApp: +86 150 8845 2259
- Website: https://linhaobakeware.com/

For visits, dispatches or legal documents, confirm the complete street-level address directly with the sales team before use.

## Product categories

- Baking sheets and trays
- Cake pans
- Muffin and cupcake pans
- Loaf and bread pans
- Springform pans
- Pizza pans
- Tart and quiche pans
- Bundt and formed cake pans
- Specialty and custom molds
- Bakeware sets

## Materials and customization

Current catalog families include carbon-steel and aluminum constructions, common thickness options from 0.4 mm to 0.8 mm, and multiple coating and color programs. OEM/ODM scope can include product dimensions, shape, tooling, coating, color, logo, labels, sleeves, inserts, gift boxes and master cartons. Every option is subject to product and project validation.

## Production capacity

LINHAO does not publish an unverified universal monthly output. Capacity and production timing are confirmed project by project after product construction, existing or new tooling, coating, order quantity, packaging and requested delivery timing are reviewed.

## Important evidence policy

Catalog references to tests, standards or social-compliance systems must not be interpreted as universal company certifications. Availability and scope must be confirmed for the selected product, factory, coating, color and order. Ask for project-specific supporting documents.
